goal: Verify the real Mycelium VM, Gitea, and model execution path by creating SMOKE.md in an isolated project repository.
assumptions: The approved dev worker is healthy and can reach the configured Gitea host and model API through its standing egress.
The Gitea organisation and service credentials are configured as documented in infra/README.md.
non_goals: Do not change existing projects, repositories, configuration, or infrastructure.
Do not add dependencies, CI, tooling, or files other than the requested smoke file.

tasks.description: Create the requested smoke file at the repository root with exactly its requested one-line content. Commit the change on the plan branch, push it, then call task_complete with the commit SHA.
